title: First Draft: Why Was Ilhan Omar’s Home Raided Over ‘Illegal Immigration’ Claims, and Not Elon Musk’s? You Know the Answer

content:

Good morning all, and welcome to Tuesday's **' First Draft.'** It's our first
newsletter of the week because Monday was the Indigenous Peoples' Day holiday,
but it wasn't a quiet day for news.

Before dawn, agents of Immigration and Customs Enforcement raided the DC home
of **Minnesota Democratic Rep. Ilhan Omar** , as part of a criminal
investigation into her immigration status. Transparently political, utterly
hypocritical, and close to high-stakes elections, it was the act of an openly
fascist regime.

Elsewhere, the man at the top of that regime, **Donald Trump** , did his best
to help **Kansas Senator Roger Marshall** , whose actions as a doctor who had
his own patients arrested are dragging him towards a surprise midterms defeat.
Trump's illegal Iran war, of course, dragged on. Let's read in.

Rep. Ilhan Omar came to the U.S. from Somalia as a refugee in the mid-1990s.
More than 25 years ago, when she was still a child, just shy of 18, her father
filed for U.S. citizenship.

Elon Musk, the SpaceX billionaire, Twitter owner, champion of the global far-
right, and GOP megadonor ($276 million and
[counting](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/12/us/politics/elon-musk-
midterms.html) in these midterms alone), also came to the U.S. from Africa in
the mid-1990s. In 2013, in an interview at the Milken Institute, his brother
Kimbal Musk said that at the start of their careers in U.S. tech the two South
Africans **" were illegal immigrants."** Elon Musk protested, **" I'd say it
was a gray area."** Kimbal Musk repeated: **" Yes, we were." **Reporting by
outlets including the _Washington Post_ - headline, **["Elon Musk, enemy of
'open borders,' launched his career working
illegally"](https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2024/10/26/elon-musk-
immigration-status/)** - seems to have backed up Kimbal's claim.

On Monday, before dawn, agents from Immigration and Customs Enforcement raided
a home in Washington, DC. Guess the owner.

Omar has long been the target of foul racist invective from Donald Trump and
MAGA, who reserve particularly disgusting animus for Somali Americans, as
demonstrated just last week by the president's [clear call for racial
violence](https://zeteo.com/p/donald-trump-is-trying-to-start-a) ahead of the
midterm elections. For years, Trump has attacked Omar in terms notably
stringent even compared to attacks on other prominent progressive women of
color, stoking right-wing conspiracy theories about her immigration status and
threatening to deport her.

But Trump has also mused about deporting Musk. In July last year, as the two
men feuded following Musk's time leading Trump's DOGE attack on the federal
government, and Musk's consequent threat to expose Trump's links to the late
financier and sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, Trump [told
reporters](https://abcnews.com/Politics/trump-hell-deporting-musk-feud-
reignites/story?id=123372908) **" We'll have to take a look"** at deporting
Musk, thereby sending him **" home to South Africa."**

So, who got raided? Hint: It's not the guy who [was also
pals](https://zeteo.com/p/elon-musk-jeffrey-epstein-files-island) with Jeffrey
Epstein.
